bucket: instrument-artifact (differential-side), repairing a defect I introduced in C29
defect: obs_exact and obs_rolled are built once before the branch loop and shared across every branch and every state. C29 assigned back into them, so a cap promotion earned by one branch leaked into all later branches whose own capped_bases were empty. The engine side was already computed into per-branch locals, so only the observed side drifted and the two sides disagreed about which bucket an identical component belonged to.
fix: Compute the observed split into per-branch locals; never mutate the shared split.
found_by: Dumping actual values at the comparison site. Five prior hypotheses, all inferred from re-reading the source, were wrong -- the logic was correct and the STATE was wrong, which source-reading cannot see.

prediction.population: all retained transition rows from the C32 sweep (7,249)
prediction.expected_now_matched: roughly 89% of the 3,779, i.e. about 3,360, by scaling the pilot
prediction.does_this_reach_a_PASS: NO, and it must not be claimed to. Even at zero structural rows the C32 run also failed on coverage 0.9587 against a 0.97 floor, on seven family bounds, and on eighteen malformed predicted_class entries. Those are independent failures this fix does not touch.

falsifiers: any row that MATCHED under C29 now diverging -- the fix must only remove false divergences
